experiment: E36A/E36B pure-EEG reproducible baseline and nested open-set evaluation

features.method: single-trial FFT ideal band isolation -> GPU covariance -> fixed shrinkage -> logSPD -> upper triangle
features.upper_band_boundaries: lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive, except 40 Hz inclusive in the last band
features.detrend: subtract each band's mean diagonal log-variance from diagonal entries only
features.zband: within each trial and band, standardize all 171 detrended logSPD entries to zero mean and unit population standard deviation

models.ridge_feature_scaling: training-fold mean and population standard deviation only

nested_protocol.outer_known_evaluation: trial > 0.8 * within-subject/task maximum; a continuous file-block proxy
nested_protocol.threshold_selection: for each score, maximize 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 subject to inner known acceptance >= 0.95; ties by C, U, AUROC, then configured score order; then select score by the same rule
nested_protocol.proxy_warning: C/U-only inner selection proxy; A is unavailable, so this is not the official competition score
nested_protocol.q05: fifth percentile of pooled inner-known confidence for the selected score

reporting.auc: unknown-detection AUROC with larger confidence indicating known; also unknown-class AUPR using negated confidence
reporting.f1: registered identity macro-F1, unknown-class F1, and joint 0–20 macro-F1 are distinguished
reporting.attacks_and_test: N/A: no attacks run and Test has no labels; Test was not read
